note: Iowa DNR recreation area on the west shore of Spirit Lake, Iowa's largest natural lake, in the Iowa Great Lakes. The region's largest campground, newly renovated with paved roads and plenty of shade, runs in a long strip along the shore; a smaller North Campground sits just north of the main entrance on 240th Avenue. Boat ramp at the park; Crandall's Beach public swim area just north on Hwy 276; paved trails link to the regional trail system. Only registered campers may enter or leave the campgrounds 10:30 pm - 4 am. No daily Iowa park-entry fee, camping fee only. --Claude
summary: Sites 224 -> 122 (94 RV + 28 tent-only), max 100, ~50 pull-throughs; sewer added (full hookups); flush toilets and water added; booking confirmed, booking season Apr 15-Oct 31 added. Lakeview stands, 0 on-water candidates.
flags: LAKEVIEW STANDS, 0 on-water candidates: RA tags all 117 sites read 'Near Water - no' (no per-site GIS for this park). On imagery the main campground is a long double row of pads on a paved loop; the east (lakeside) pads back onto a continuous tree belt ~25-50 m deep before the Spirit Lake shore, so no pad has open ground to the water; views would be filtered through those trees at best. The North Campground (112-122) sits west of the water beyond trees too. Nothing to raise.
